_about: What each combat skill's icon (skill bar, skill book, altar) shows, for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set skills. The skill as one object in action, with its effect: a bold shape and one strong colour each, so they tell apart on the skill bar.
AshladsEmber: A small old wooden tinderbox, its lid open, a big solid cone of bright orange fire and chunky sparks bursting out of it
FrostRune: A jagged spear of solid pale blue ice crystal flying forward, the Norse rune Isa (a single straight vertical line) glowing white on it, solid ice shards breaking off behind it
HeartrootsGrasp: Thick gnarled tree roots bursting up out of a clod of dark earth and curling like grasping fingers, glowing faint green along the bark
HuldrasBlessing: A cupped pair of slender green leaves holding a softly glowing golden-green orb of light, small white flowers and sparkles around it
TrollsbaneWrath: A huge heavy war hammer with a dark iron head bound with leather, striking down onto cracked rock, chunks of broken stone flying out
WhirlingSteel: Three Norse steel swords arranged in a spinning pinwheel around a centre point, their tips joined by thick curved solid silver crescent swoosh shapes, like a whirlwind of blades
WolfsLunge: The head of a snarling grey wolf leaping forward with jaws open, a streak of motion behind it
MountainLeap: A huge grey boulder slamming down onto the ground, a wide ring of dust and cracked earth bursting out around it, rock chips flying
